name: PostParcel
concept: The post parcel of the delivery job: a flat brown-paper packet tied with string, of the kind the 1989 post office took across the counter. A courier picks it up in both hands, carries it to the addressee, and it can lie on the ground or a shelf.
prompt: A post parcel of the 1980s: a flat rectangular package wrapped in plain brown kraft paper with crisp folded corners, tied round both ways with thin string in a cross and a knot on top, a blank rectangular white address label on the top face and a small red wax seal on the string. no text, no logos.
